name: internal
justification: Live skill has pricing.model=free and auth.scope=null — an operator-only utility route by the gateway's own metadata (no scope to grant, nothing to meter), not a customer-facing capability. Documenting it as a public operation would misrepresent it as purchasable.

name: kwh
justification: KWH issues metering and signed receipts for active agent work (ontology domains/kwh; ruling documents/d-domain-rulings-oct9). Probed 2026-10-09 6:59 PM ET: every /v1/kwh, GET and POST, on gateway.wave.online answers 503 SPOKE_NOT_LIVE, so there is no served operation to document yet. Add real operations when the KWH spoke has a live origin. Honored only while the index carries no meter.

name: kya
justification: KYA is identity: a public, stranger-checkable agent record, free forever (ontology domains/kya; documents/d-kya-k7-free-with-enterprise). The served free identity op is already documented as identityResolve (/identity/resolve). Probed 2026-10-09 6:59 PM ET: every /v1/kya, GET and POST, on gateway.wave.online answers 503 SPOKE_NOT_LIVE, so there is no served operation to document yet. Honored only while the index carries no meter.

name: vrfy
